Hi Kajal, welcome! It's great to finally meet you.  Thanks for taking the time to interview today. I've reviewed your resume and I'm impressed with your projects, especially the Java-based inventory management system and the web-based expense tracker.  It shows a good understanding of several programming languages and technologies.

To get us started, could you please tell me a little bit about yourself?  I'd love to hear about your background, your interests within the field of computer science, and what you’re hoping to achieve in your career.

Your Inventory Management System project mentions using a custom data structure. Can you tell me more about the specific data structure you chose and why you felt it was the most appropriate solution for managing the inventory data?

Kajal, thank you so much for taking the time to speak with me today.  I’ve truly enjoyed learning more about your experience and skills, and I found our conversation incredibly insightful.  The team will be reviewing all applications, and we’ll be in touch within [ timeframe, e.g.,  the next week ] to let you know the next steps in the hiring process.  Thank you again for your interest in [Company Name]. We wish you all the best.
